Subject: Renewal kickoff: BrightLayer — accordion term + phased capacity (QBR scheduling)

Hi Elena + team,

Thanks for confirming interest in continuing with Redwood. Per our preliminary discussions, BrightLayer is targeting a term adjustment and a staged capacity increase to support the new feature rollout in H1 2027. I want to kick off the renewal conversation and align on timeline, stakeholders, and a QBR window to lock commercial and operational items.

High-level proposal:
- Term: 18-month accordion (12 + 6) with optional mid-term review.
- Capacity: phased ramp — 50% committed on day 1, scale to 100% over 12 weeks; burst pool available for traffic spikes.
- Pricing: blended unit rate for initial 12 months, with step-up for the optional 6-month extension.

Action items I propose this week:
1) Book a 45-min kickoff / QBR to align execs and procurement — two proposed windows below.
2) Share mutual action plan (MAP) for legal/procurement milestones (attached).
3) Internal staffing note — Ben to propose an ops rotation and throughput plan; Irene to prepare SOC2 snapshot for procurement.

Proposed QBR windows:
- Tues Jun 15, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thurs Jun 17, 13:00–13:45 PT

Attachments: renewal_summary_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

If those windows work, I’ll send a calendar invite and pull in Legal/Finance. If not, please send up to two windows that work for your team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in motion.

Best,
Monica Patel

- Phase 0 (dec-01 start): 50% committed baseline (~6M tokens/day equivalent) + 20% burst capacity.
- Phase 1 (week 5): +25% commitment (to 75%).
- Phase 2 (week 12): 100% committed baseline; continual burst for spiky traffic.

- One dedicated SRE contact for onboarding (we can staff from Redwood for first 8 weeks).
- Routine weekly sync for first 6 weeks, then bi-weekly.
